name: BACH_0107
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set and second-model agreement support this, but only 2 of 5 similar cases are Invasive.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive >99%, InSitu <1% | Very high |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 94th percentile | Input reliable |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Top classes agree |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Invasive [F5] | Neighbors mostly InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce tubules; low score adds to invasive association [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score in one region [F4] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 9, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical nuclear atypia scores · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Benign-looking counterweight · Validated
- **Epithelial nuclei fraction** (regions 1, 5) · context · 81% of nuclei (93rd percentile); tumor nuclei insufficient · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. TILs, the largest term, is Weak (8/20).

## Could be wrong if
- 3 of 5 similar cases are InSitu; the Invasive call may be overconfident.
- Cell sample (regions 1, 5) has insufficient tumor nuclei; epithelial fraction failed its direction check.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 4, 1** — confirm invasive growth in stroma, not an in-situ pattern.
2. **Region 11** — benign-looking stroma with a gland signal; check for benign or in-situ tissue.
3. **Region 3** — possible intraductal atypia (spot check 12/20); confirm whether cells are duct-confined.
